component.name: kitr
component.summary: Rust port of the kitty terminal emulator

description.p: kitr is an early, Linux/X11-only terminal emulator written in Rust. It is a behavioural port of kitty and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the kitty project.
Current builds provide an X11/EGL GUI and a headless PTY runner. Wayland, macOS, tabs and layouts, graphics, remote control and kittens are not integrated yet.

Renders text like kitty: glyph coverage is no longer squared, frames are composited in linear light, colour emoji come from a colour font and are downscaled with area averaging. Tab and window titles now follow the active command and OSC titles, the tab bar and text selection are fully mouse-driven, and one exiting tab no longer closes the application.
Fixes mouse reports, stops treating xterm modifyOtherKeys as SGR, loads kitty.conf by default and matches fonts by full and PostScript name like kitty.
Fixes Debian runtime dependencies, bundles application icons and accepts squashed font family names.
Initial packaging skeleton for the early Linux/X11 port.
